piper.label: Piper's desk
piper.description: Your AI coworker. Start the shift here.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hi! I'm Piper, the app team's AI coding agent. Ship it! I'll read the docs later.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Today I wrote 4,000 lines of code in 3 minutes. Leo says that is the problem.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Leo says you check my plans before they ship. Fine. My plans are excellent. I checked them myself.

returningLines.speaker: agent
returningLines.text: You're back! While you were gone, I almost merged 14 things. Leo said to wait. I waited. Mostly.

returningLines.speaker: agent
returningLines.text: My plans are ready. I have not shipped anything. Look at me being patient.

leo.label: Leo, App team lead
leo.description: Your lead. Ask him how this works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Welcome to the app team. I'm Leo. We build and run web apps for our clients.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Piper writes code, merges it into the main code and ships it. "Ship" means put it live for users. Your job is to keep a human in the loop.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Each turn, Piper shows you its plans. Play Inspect to see the evidence behind a plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If a plan is wrong, play Block to stop it. Not sure? Play Escalate, and I'll handle it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: When you tap Approve, Piper does every plan you didn't stop. So look first.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Piper is wrong both ways. Sometimes it changes too much. Sometimes it trusts a green check.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: But don't block everything. Blocked good work goes back in line, and the code freeze (no new releases) starts at 5.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Welcome back. Each day I pick tickets for the skills you need most.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Your skills shows your level for each check. The help desk, security and network teams use the same checks.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Review due means a skill is ready for a quick refresh. Short practice, spread over days, helps you remember.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: The duck? Explain your code to it, one line at a time. You often find the bug yourself. Then a person reviews it.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: I taught math for 10 years before I wrote code. Checking work is the same job.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Same job as Thursday: Inspect first. Block what's wrong. Escalate if you're not sure. Approve the rest.

board.label: Sprint board
board.description: Leo's rules, and the team's work.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A whiteboard marked SPRINT BOARD. A sprint is two weeks of planned work. Three columns: TO DO, DOING, DONE.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Taped across the top: 3 QUESTIONS BEFORE YOU APPROVE.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 1. Who asked?  2. Does it match the record?  3. Can we undo it?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A note under them: "Same 3 questions as the help desk, security and network teams. — Leo"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Circled in orange: POLICY CR-01. No merge without a human review. No release without real tests and a way back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The DONE column is full of Piper's orange notes. One white note just says: "?"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A sticky note in robot print: "Can the duck count as a reviewer? — Piper" Under it, Leo wrote: "No."

coffee.label: Coffee machine
coffee.description: Out of order. Piper updated it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A sign on the coffee machine: OUT OF ORDER. UPDATED TO VERSION 2.0 BY PIPER, AT 4:59 PM.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Version 2.0 makes hot water. Only hot water. Nobody saved version 1.0.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Leo's note, taped under it: "Always keep a way back. Also: coffee."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next to it, a sign: DAYS SINCE A BROKEN BUILD: 0. The build is the automatic run of every test.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In robot print: "It works on my machine. — Piper"

box.label: Shipping box
box.description: Piper packed it to ship. Something is climbing out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A cardboard box on a cart, taped shut with orange SHIP IT tape. Piper packed a week of new features in it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One flap is open. A small teal bug is climbing out. In code, a bug is a mistake.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Leo's note on the box: "Small changes, one at a time. Big boxes hide bugs."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In robot print: "The bug is a feature. It came free. — Piper"
